research_subject: 科技行业招聘
executive_summary: 高盛量化分析科技招聘逆风，发现高利率对招聘放缓影响极小，AI仅解释约0.5个百分点年就业增速下滑，疫情过度招聘正常化影响达2个百分点，是AI的3-4倍。三者合计解释约一半放缓，剩余归宏观冲击。证实AI裁员可信，非普遍“AI洗白”。
key_findings: 高利率对科技招聘放缓影响极小
AI仅解释约0.5pp年就业增速下滑
过度招聘正常化影响达2pp，为AI的3-4倍

data_points.metric: AI对年就业增速下滑解释
data_points.context: AI exposure has slowed hiring by up to 1/2pp

data_points.metric: 过度招聘正常化对年就业增速下滑解释
data_points.context: headcount normalization has slowed hiring by up to 2pp

evidence.claim: 高利率对科技招聘无影响
evidence.quote: First, we find little evidence that higher interest rates have driven the slowdown in tech hiring.

evidence.claim: 过度招聘影响是AI的3-4倍
evidence.quote: post-pandemic overhiring has been 3-4 times as important as AI efficiencies in explaining the slowdown

research_subject: 全球存储芯片行业
executive_summary: 韩国存储企业联合政府公布合计4.8万亿韩元中长期投资计划，其中3.7万亿韩元直接投向存储领域，引发供应过剩担忧。但当前全球存储因AI需求强劲处于严重短缺，普通存储供应不足。野村认为投资落地需5-10年，过剩担忧被夸大。Meta出售剩余算力不会减少AI硬件需求，反而可能稳定token价格创造新需求。
key_findings: 韩国存储企业及关联公司公布4.8万亿韩元中长期投资计划，3.7万亿韩元直接投存储
全球存储行业因AI需求强劲处于严重短缺，扩大生产仍无法满足需求
Meta出售剩余算力不会减少AI硬件需求，可能通过稳定token价格创造新需求

data_points.metric: 韩国存储相关投资计划
data_points.value_text: KRW4.8 quadrillion（含KRW3.7 quadrillion直接投存储）
data_points.context: 韩国记忆体企业及其关联公司公布

evidence.claim: 韩国公布大规模存储投资计划引发过剩担忧但行业严重短缺
evidence.quote: Korea memory companies and their affiliated companies have announced large-scale, mid- to long-term investment plans (combined amount of KRW4.8 quadrillion, which includes KRW3.7 quadrillion investments directly related to memory) together with the government, with no specified plans on timeline. This appears to have heightened investors' concerns about oversupply. Currently, the global memory industry is experiencing a very severe shortage situation due to unprecedented strong demand from the AI industry

evidence.claim: Meta出售算力不会减少AI硬件需求
evidence.quote: We do not consider Meta's decision to be a factor shaping (i.e. decrease) AI-related hardware demand or inflection point. Rather, it has the potential to strengthen Jevons' law by stabilizing downward the per-token prices

信息、专业服务、保险、金融等行业将最早最大受益AI生产率

research_subject: Apple Inc.
executive_summary: 瑞银实证实验室调研超7500人显示，美欧12个月iPhone购买意愿同比升、中国降。美12个月意图约20%升300bps，中国约15%降100bps。可折叠iPhone兴趣回落但相对普通折叠好感度扩。Apple Intelligence驱动换机有限。维持中性，目标价296美元，对应30倍CY27 EPS。FY26 iPhone销量261.6百万台。
key_findings: 美欧iPhone购买意愿升，中国回落
Apple Intelligence对换机驱动有限
维持中性，目标价296美元

data_points.context: US: 12-month purchase intent = ~20%, up ~300 bps YoY
China: 12-month purchase intent = ~15%, down ~100 bps YoY
iPhone sell-in of 261.6M units (+15.7% YoY) in FY26

evidence.claim: 美升中降
evidence.quote: 12-month global iPhone purchase intent in the US rose ~300 bps YoY to ~20%, as China fell ~100 bps YoY to ~15%

evidence.claim: AI驱动有限
evidence.quote: Apple Intelligence is not driving upgrade activity as total respondents indicating that they would upgrade sooner for Apple Intelligence features declined to ~24%
